definitions: Particular forms of something differing in certain respects from an earlier form or other forms of the same type of thing.
Accounts of a matter from particular points of view, especially as contrasted with other accounts.
Adaptations of a work of art or literature into another medium or style.
examples: There are several versions of the software available.
Each witness gave a different version of events.
The film is one of many versions of the classic novel.
